title: Round 11 / ECDLP-39: algebraic decision-tree barrier (branching) and batched SLP review
question: Algebraic decision-tree barrier (conjecture): any algebraic decision tree over F_p with equality branching (tests f(u) = 0 on intermediate values), single input u = x(Q), depth D and leaf programs of length L (with division defined on their leaf sets), that outputs k at u = x(kP) for 1 <= k <= N, 2N < r, satisfies L + c·D >= log2 N − O(1) for an absolute constant c; obstacle: leaves partition the nodes arbitrarily, and partial-agreement bounds need additive structure (progressions) in each leaf set (Behrend-type sets may avoid it).
rationale: DEC allocation: strongest open math; plus mandatory review of PRF-58cf340e and the division-SLP PRF.
success_criteria: Exact statements; proofs or precise obstructions; reproducible checks.
resource_limit: Two bounded subagents; no recursion; no commits; ~90 min.
